label: agent loop • HTML write/read preserves source without rewrite
query: Create index.html with a div whose id is grid and an inline script that sets that div's textContent to READY. Then use file_read to verify the saved raw HTML source still contains both the <script> tag and the grid selector. If the read confirms them, do not rewrite the file.
notes: Regression for workspace HTML being routed through rich-document extraction: file_read returned only rendered page text after a successful write, causing the agent to misdiagnose truncation and repeatedly overwrite the file.
